name: MinecraftMaterialRef - Default (seed v1)
description: A Minecraft material (item, block or banner) by its namespaced key. Item blueprints, gates and categories pick one of these as their material or icon.

sections.description: The material as Minecraft knows it. A row is added the first time the material is picked from the material catalog in a form.

fields.label: Namespaced key
fields.description: The id Minecraft and the plugin use for this material, e.g. minecraft:oak_log.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: ITEM, BLOCK or BANNER, from the material catalog. Only blocks can be placed in the world.

fields.label: Legacy name
fields.description: Older material name kept for reference when the catalog has one. Usually empty.

fields.label: Icon image
fields.description: Web address of the picture the web app shows for this material. Comes from the catalog (minecraft-assets).
